propositions: config.py at 869 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC soft cap and is grandfathered in allowlist/ceilings with a stale documented remedy.
The documented remedy seam (split dataclass/schema from env/CLI machinery) is already shipped to _config_schema.py, rendering the remedy row obsolete.

The extracted _config_sources.py must re-export through config.py to preserve ~90 importers and maintain _TOML_CACHE object identity and monkeypatch interceptability.
The stale remedy row must be removed from docs/architecture.md, config.py must be delisted from both allowlist and ceilings, and the existing config test suite must pass.
